description: This file defines the CoreConfiguration class which manages application properties, providing getter and setter methods, as well as property retrieval with default values. It is integrated with Spring via the @Component annotation.

classes.name: CoreConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that encapsulates application properties, allowing retrieval and modification of configuration data.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the Properties object containing configuration properties.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the Properties object with new configuration.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property given its key.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property with a default fallback if the property is missing or inaccessible.
